items.title: Outpostkrewhirl86/Capri-AI
items.description: Capri: a local-first desktop AI agent with a cyberpunk HUD. Your personal Jarvis for Windows. Controls files, apps, terminal and browser, powered by Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or any backend. Inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
